ARC-018's PASS/FAIL split is not noise: every PASS (EXQ-042, EXQ-053, EXQ-120) tested the post-commitment VIABILITY MAPPING leg, and every FAIL (EXQ-172, EXQ-196) tested the ROLLOUT leg. Carrying the conjunction at exp_conf 0.547 averages a well-supported leg with an unsupported one and hides both facts. Critically the rollout leg is UNTESTED, NOT REFUTED: EXQ-172 ran at e2_world_r2 = 0.203 (its own note concludes ARC-018 'may be E2-quality-gated' -- a negative advantage from a poor forward model indicts E2, not the architecture), and EXQ-196 returned harm_advantage_mean EXACTLY 0.0 on all 3 seeds at good fidelity (e2_world_r2 0.766), an exact-zero-everywhere degeneracy signature meaning the rollout output never reached the DV -- which is why governance classified it non_contributory and deferred the verdict.

The EXQ-396 series (396a x3, 396b) died on a train/eval variance gap -- train variance ~0.000032-0.000064 vs eval variance ~0.001, roughly 15-30x -- so a threshold set at 2 x training_baseline_variance never engages during eval. All four runs were reclassified non_contributory and nobody has since re-run them with the threshold derived from eval-time variance.

Test whether distractor resistance has three DISSOCIABLE failure modes, and close the coverage gap that REE's distractor evidence is rule-corruption ONLY. V3-EXQ-484 (salience-coordinator gating protects rule state from replay drift) and MECH-262 (rule-selective distractor-resistant persistence) both instrument rule corruption. Sensory capture and BEHAVIOURAL CAPTURE are untested. Behavioural capture is the load-bearing leg because it is the failure that rule-state protection CANNOT CATCH BY CONSTRUCTION -- an intact rule that fails to steer action is invisible to a rule-drift metric. This is a diagnostic over existing substrate, NOT a new attention module.

Establish whether behavioural-competence updates need the bounded / provenanced / rollback-capable discipline that the memory-consolidation path already has (MECH-392 provenance+contradiction-flag+rollback, INV-080 raw-episode preservation, MECH-401 gated-write authority). The question this answers is the intake's own: does a LOCAL competence update degrade UNRELATED competences?

Supplies the promotion gate that MECH-471's bounded-update discipline would need in order to decide WHEN an update has earned durability.
